Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final input = await createExtractInputFromJson(json: '{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"text/plain","uri":"https://example.com/text/report.txt"}');
    final config = await createExtractionConfigFromJson(json: '{"captioning":{"llm":{"max_concurrency":2,"model":"openai/gpt-4o"},"min_image_area":1000},"concurrency":{"max_threads":8}}');
    final result = await XbergBridge.extract(input, config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].mimeType);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].content);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
